headline: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia files SEBI compliance certificate with BSE and NSE
hook: Routine regulatory filing by infrastructure company
summary: Infrastructure player Vishnu Prakash R Punglia has submitted its mandatory SEBI compliance certificate to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange. This is a routine procedural filing required of listed companies to confirm adherence to market regulations. For an Indian retail investor, this carries no direct financial impact or operational shift.
why_it_matters: No material impact on share price or company fundamentals.

headline: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Scrutinizer report filed for September AGM
summary: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company. Retail shareholders can review the detailed resolution outcomes on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price
